webhook.endpointForm.secretNote: A signing secret is generated on save and shown only once.
webhook.endpointForm.urlPattern: Enter a complete URL. Allowed protocols and public addresses are checked by Platform.
webhook.endpoints.empty: This Client has no endpoints yet
webhook.endpoints.note: Each Client can have up to {limit} endpoints (including disabled ones), and endpoints can't be deleted. The signing secret is shown only once, on creation and rotation; after rotation the previous secret keeps signing for 1 hour by default.
webhook.failure.BLOCKED_ADDRESS: Address resolved to an internal network and was blocked
webhook.filters.endBeforeStart: The end time must be later than the start time.
webhook.filters.incompleteRange: Select both a start and an end time.
webhook.filters.rangeTooLong: The time range can't exceed {days} days.
webhook.management.clientNotFound: Client {clientId} wasn't found, or it doesn't have platform access.

webhook.modal.conflict: This endpoint was changed by someone else; what you see isn't the latest.
webhook.modal.reasonPlaceholder: Required; recorded in the audit log

webhook.rotate.grace: Keep signing with the previous secret for 1 hour (recommended)

webhook.rotate.immediateHint: For a leaked secret; deliveries fail signature verification until the Client updates

webhook.secretOnce.copyFailed: Can't access the clipboard. Select the secret and copy it manually.

webhook.secretOnce.saved: I've saved the secret and given it to the Client
webhook.secretOnce.title: Signing Secret Generated

webhook.status.disableImpact: Once disabled, no new events are delivered; unfinished deliveries are cancelled on their next run. Re-enabling doesn't resend events from the disabled period.
